capability_gaps.reason: Offset diagnostic needs to be scoped to a specific carrier feed cohort; no cohort record exists yet. Must trace order flow first.

next_action.rationale: Trace the 186 stuck orders through the system to identify: (1) which carrier feed cohort they belong to, (2) their handoff sequence through allocation → carrier booking → pickup, (3) where the handoff chain breaks. This will allow us to scope the offset read to the correct cohort and understand whether the failure is in carrier booking or pickup confirmation.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Discriminates between allocation_rule_defect (failure in booking creation) and carrier_feed_lag (failure in confirmation flow). Also enables targeted offset read.
